description.en: RDF version of the Apertium bilingual dictionary EU-ES. The original dataset (in LMF) comes from <http://hdl.handle.net/10230/17095> . The RDF version of the lexica is modelled using lemon (http://lemon-model.net/) and the translation module (http://purl.org/net/translation). More about the Apertium RDF dictionaries at http://linguistic.linkeddata.es/apertium/

other_download.description: This online lexicon not only contains the EU lexical entries from the EU-ES bilingual dictionary (that can be found in the zipped dump) but also aggregates the lexical entries in EU coming from all the published Apertium RDF dictionaries.
